name: shadPS4

biosRequirements.label: PS4 firmware modules (optional)
biosRequirements.note: Optional .sprx modules dumped from your own PS4 (shadPS4 README 'Firmware files'). OmniPC points shadPS4's sys_modules folder here; system fonts go in fonts\font and fonts\font2. OmniPC never downloads firmware.

notes: shadPS4 is an early PlayStation 4 emulator: some games are playable, many are not yet, and compatibility changes between releases. See https://github.com/shadps4-compatibility/shadps4-game-compatibility.
Requires a GPU and driver with Vulkan 1.3 and a CPU with AVX2 (x86-64-v3).
OmniPC installs the shadPS4 core (shadPS4.exe, no Qt launcher) and launches games directly with -g <game>/eboot.bin. Games are PS4 folder dumps (eboot.bin with sce_sys/param.sfo next to it).
Emulator data lives in the OmniPC data folder for shadPS4 (portable 'user' folder); saves and trophies live in the OmniPC Saves folder (General.home_dir).
Firmware modules (.sprx) and system fonts are optional and must be dumped from your own console; OmniPC points shadPS4 at BIOS/ps4 and never downloads them.

Controller: the universal profile is written to input_config/default.ini (gamepad lines only; keyboard bindings are kept). Hotkeys (modifier + button) open the quit dialog, toggle fullscreen, change volume, take a screenshot or open the in-game settings. Rumble cannot be turned off and the player-1 device cannot be chosen.
Per-game profiles use shadPS4's own custom_configs/<TITLE_ID>.json (fullscreen, vsync, window size).
assumptions: Verified against shadps4-emu/shadPS4 main @ 811bfcd (CMakeLists.txt version 0.19.1-dev); latest stable tag v.0.19.0.

Releases: stable releases (tags v.X.Y.Z, e.g. v.0.19.0) are created manually and marked Latest; CI (.github/workflows/build.yml job 'pre-release') publishes 'Pre-release-shadPS4-<date>-<hash>' releases with prerelease: true, so /releases/latest returns the stable release. v.0.19.0 assets (releases/expanded_assets/v.0.19.0): shadps4-win64-sdl-0.19.0.zip, shadps4-linux-sdl-0.19.0.zip, shadps4-macos-sdl-0.19.0.zip. The Windows artifact is build/shadPS4.exe (build.yml windows-sdl 'Upload Windows SDL artifact'); the zip contents of the stable asset were not inspected, the installer locates shadPS4.exe anywhere in the archive.

Windows build: clang-cl, default (dynamic) MSVC runtime -> Visual C++ x64 redistributable; -march=x86-64-v3 (CMakeLists.txt) -> AVX2 required. src/dist/shadps4.rc gives shadPS4.exe a VERSIONINFO of MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.0.

CLI (src/main.cpp, CLI11): -g/--game <path or title id> (also positional), -f/--fullscreen true|false, -p/--patch, -i/--ignore-game-patch, -b/--big-picture, --config-clean, --config-global, --show-fps, --add-game-folder, --override-root, --log-append, -- <guest args>. No args -> modal 'This is a CLI application' message box (OmniPC always passes args). --help is CLI11's built-in flag: prints usage and exits 0 before logging/config load.

Game target: an existing path is used directly; a directory gets /eboot.bin appended and the parent folder is mounted as /app0 (src/emulator.cpp Run). The title ID comes from sce_sys/param.sfo CONTENT_ID[7..16] or TITLE_ID.

User data folder (src/common/path_util.cpp UserPaths, static init): <current working directory>/user if it exists, else %APPDATA%\shadPS4 on Windows. OmniPC creates Emulators/shadps4/data/user and starts shadPS4 with cwd = data. Subfolders: log, screenshots, shader, data, temp, sys_modules, download, captures, cheats, patches, game_data, custom_trophy, custom_configs, cache, fonts, trophy, home, custom_modules, licenses.

Settings are JSON, not TOML: user/config.json with groups General/Network/Log/Debug/Input/Audio/GPU/Vulkan (src/core/emulator_settings.h/.cpp). Load merges file values over defaults; Save keeps unknown keys. A parse or type error aborts startup (Load -> UNREACHABLE_MSG), so OmniPC type-checks managed keys.

Startup dialogs: (1) 'Config Migration' message box when user/config.json is missing but a legacy user/config.toml exists (EmulatorSettingsImpl::Load) - OmniPC always writes config.json first. (2) 'Save Migration' message box whenever <home_dir>/1000 does not exist (UserManager::CreateDefaultUsers -> AskMigrationOption, run on every UserSettings.Load) - OmniPC pre-creates <home>/1000..1003 with savedata/trophy/inputs. General.show_splash is set false (default false). The core has no update checker and no other message boxes outside Big Picture mode.

Paths: General.home_dir (PS4 home: <home>/<user id>/savedata/<TITLE_ID>, <home>/<user id>/trophy; save_instance.cpp, user_manager.cpp) -> OmniPC Saves/shadps4. General.sys_modules_dir (libs.cpp InitHLELibs, sysmodule_internal.cpp, linker.cpp libSceLibcInternal.sprx; per-game modules in <dir>/<TITLE_ID>) -> BIOS/ps4. General.font_dir (emulator.cpp mounts <dir>/font and <dir>/font2) -> BIOS/ps4/fonts. Empty values fall back to user/home, user/sys_modules, user/fonts.

Graphics keys: GPU.full_screen (bool), GPU.full_screen_mode ('Windowed'|'Fullscreen'|'Fullscreen (Borderless)'; anything but 'Fullscreen' gives desktop fullscreen, sdl_window.cpp), GPU.present_mode 'Mailbox' (default)|'Fifo'|'Immediate' (vk_swapchain.cpp), GPU.window_width/height (u32), GPU.internal_screen_width/height (u32 video-out resolution reported to the game, video_out.cpp RegisterLib; default 1280x720). There is no internal-resolution upscaler setting besides FSR (left to the user).

Per-game: user/custom_configs/<TITLE_ID>.json, loaded after the global config when the game starts (EmulatorSettingsImpl::Load(serial)); only GetOverrideableFields keys apply (GPU.full_screen, present_mode, window_width/height ... but not internal_screen_*). Partial files are valid. --config-clean/--config-global bypass them.

Logs: user/log/shadps4.log during startup, then user/log/shad_log.txt for the game (Log.separate=true would use <TITLE_ID>.log instead; OmniPC sets false) (common/logging/log.cpp Setup/Switch, emulator.cpp).

Input (src/input/input_handler.cpp/.h): user/input_config/default.ini is used for every game when Input.use_unified_input_config is true (default), else <TITLE_ID>.ini copied from default.ini; global.ini is loaded for all games. Line format 'output = input[, input[, input]]' with optional ':gamepad' suffixes; gamepad input tokens cross/circle/square/triangle/l1/r1/l2/r2/l3/r3/options/back/pad_*/axis_*; 'analog_deadzone = leftjoystick, inner, outer' (1..127). Multiple lines per output are all active; multi-key bindings take priority. Guide/stick directions have no button token.

Hotkeys (string_to_hotkey_map): hotkey_quit (opens the quit overlay), hotkey_fullscreen, hotkey_volume_up/down, hotkey_screenshot_with_overlays, hotkey_emulator_settings, hotkey_pause, hotkey_show_fps, ... Upstream appends keyboard defaults to global.ini only for hotkey outputs that have no line yet, so OmniPC writes the keyboard default next to each controller chord. There is no save-state or fast-forward.
Window close (SDL_EVENT_QUIT) ends the process (emulator.cpp Run -> quick_exit). A game-requested restart relaunches shadPS4 as a new process and the original exits (Emulator::Relaunch).
No rumble on/off setting and no player-1 device selection in the core (controller.cpp); Input.default_controller_id is not used by the core.
